name: Density Threshold Filtering
aliases: Volume Density Thresholding for Point Cloud Extraction
definition: A post-processing step for extracting point clouds from NeRF-based volume rendering methods (Mega-NeRF, Block-NeRF, DVGO) where points are selected along rays based on a pre-defined density threshold to reduce noise and outliers.
summary: Density Threshold Filtering extracts 3D point clouds from NeRF volume rendering by retaining only points exceeding a global density threshold, directly cleaning volumetric output to remove noise and outliers.
